findings.claim: The updated OpenSpec context still cites hosted CI runner coverage as a project convention, violating the local-only validation constraint.
findings.evidence: The hunk changes the convention text to: "Existing CI covers windows-latest + ubuntu-latest + macos-latest; phase agent-team-creator uses local validation." The packet constraint says: "Never use GitHub Actions or any hosted CI/CD runner for testing or validation" and "Do not ... cite a GitHub Actions test workflow."
findings.suggested_fix: Remove the CI coverage sentence from openspec/config.yaml and state that platform claims require actual local execution on that platform or must be reported as unverified.
